name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: A composable app sidebar: provider, header, content, groups, menu items with one level of submenus, a workspace switcher, a user menu, a footer and a resize handle that works by drag and by keyboard. Collapses to a column of icons, where submenus open in a popover and items name themselves in tooltips, or to the left edge; toggles with ⌘B, remembers its state, and opens as a drawer below 768px.
